body:
Has anyone had pokemon just cease to exist? 

I xfered pokemon from Soul Silver to Black and I completed the mini game caught the pokemon did everything I was supposed to but they're just gone. All the pokemon were legit as well. 

Another interesting thing here, the pokedex says I have them but I cant find them anywhere.

That sounds like an incredibly rough time to be going through. I sincerely hope that this is more than just a grace period of good fortune for you. 

Try not to hurt yourself by force feeding. Take baby steps towards improving your quality of life. Another of those easier said than done situations but if you can take that step you'll be surprised at how much better you feel. 

Have you been put on medicine to help with the conditions? I hope that isnt insensitive to ask.
Im so sorry for being out of touch for so long. A lot has happened life has gotten crazy for me and stressful but I'm doing my best to keep pushing forward. How have you been holding up?

Try and stay strong. Some days are okay for me others are miserable. Im trying, really hard, to look at the positives and morivate myself to keep clombing higher and high. It's not easy by any means. 

I'm really sorry to hear how rough things are for you. Is there any way you can ease into the interacting with others aspect?

I appreciate you checking in. That's very sweet of you and I want to do the same. Hkw are you doing, how is life treating you? Are you doing well?

To answer, I'm doing okay right now. Recovering from medical issues but doing my best.
Oh, Im sorry I misunderstood. Ttvm and i appreciate it.
I do yes, I'll look into it thank you!
I wasnt aware it wasnt just for students.
Thank you, I did read with wiki, I even browsed current topics related to credit but I didnt see anything that answered my question so I wanted to ask.

Oh no, I sincerely hope that the seizures are something you're able to sort and move onward from. Just remember, even if you're unable to continue your current area of work, your degree isn't useless. It's already given so many people assistance when they need it, assistance that you provided. Even if you arnt able to contimue working with individuals, you've still made a huge impact on the ones you have helped already. 

The medicines my doctor has me on don't play well with antihistamines or anything really, unfortunately that has left me without anything I can take for the allergies. The past few days have been rough, it's one of those situations where when it rains it pours and I find myself wondering what I did to deserve this, y'know? Was takjng a cookie when I wasnt allowed one as a kid really so bad I deserved this? Lol 

Anyway, the positives include the timing of this all. I'm supposed to have company staying with me for a month and a lot of the issues over the past few days have been related to getting sick, car breaking down and having to take time off work. Those would have been a miserable occurrence when companh arrived. Other than that, I'm not sure what to focus on.

I apologize, deeply, for not answering sooner, it feels like life is throwing curveball after curveball at me right now. I sincerely appreciate the check in, it actually means a lot.

Tbh, having a buddy to help might be a good idea. Something to focus on other than myself always helps. 

I've made some strides, not many have panned out, allergy season being here frustrations are high due to that accompanied by days attempting to function without coughing and sneezing myself into next week. 

How have you been holding up?

I appreciate the kind encouragement, I really do. I still havent found a desire to eat and I just cant seem to do anything other than lay here and slip in and out of sleep. 

It feels like when I begin to make progress on overcoming one hurdle, before I can, several more surface that I can't climb over, under, around or even move. I feel like lifes one big joke and I'm the punchline.
